observations.body: The LORD gives Moses words to speak directly to Pharaoh.
observations.label: Speech chain

observations.body: Israel is named son and firstborn before Pharaoh’s firstborn son is threatened.
observations.label: Firstborn relation

observations.body: Release for service is answered in advance by a warning tied to refusal.
observations.label: Demand and consequence

payload.posture: Stay with this witness’s people, objects, speech, sequence, and stated connections before moving to another account or later use.
payload.tension: The warning places collective sonship and the threatened death of an individual firstborn in one compressed exchange.
payload.title: Israel is named firstborn before Pharaoh is warned
